name: Kisvarsány (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kisvarsány: a blue and red shield with a tree, an apple, a bunch of grapes and a yellow eagle, above a scroll inscribed KISVARSÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
